What's new in 2.1.7

  • Added backward-compatible Penumbra metadata detection on every mod load.
  • Added donor PAP workflows, expression support, PAP details, and donor TMB batch cleanup.
  • Added PAP/VFX filename synchronization with JSON reference updates and collision handling.
  • Added full mod backup and restore with automatic-backup retention controls.
  • Improved Settings organization, file pickers, progress feedback, and batch audio controls.

For full details see the release page: https://github.com/solona-m/STAGE/releases
